final_answer: The key feature of the transformer architecture is its utilization of **attention mechanisms**, which enable the model to capture long-range dependencies and contextual relationships between words or tokens in a sequence. This attention-based approach allows transformers to achieve state-of-the-art performance across various domains and tasks.
